text:
Swiss watch exports rose 9.1% in October, and that is worth knowing if you follow the market.

October exports reached CHF 2.46 billion. From January to October, exports were CHF 21.9 billion, up 3.4% on last year.

The US rose about 61% in October, but is slightly down for the first ten months. US tariffs of 39%, set in August 2025, are the background.

These are export figures, not shop sales. Do you think the US number will hold through the end of the year? Tell us below.

Source: bluewin.ch, "Swiss watch exports continue to trend upward in October", reported 28 November 2026 (citing Swiss watch industry export data for October 2026).
